question: The title of Asthana Narthaki (‘Resident Dancer’) was bestowed upon by the Tirumala Tirupathi Devasthanam temple to whom among the following prominent dancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yamini Krishnamurthy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy **

 
 
• On **December 20, 1940, Yamini Krishnamurthy** was born in** Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• She is an outstanding **Kuchipudi and Bharatnatyam dancer** from India.
 
• In** Madras**, Yamini Krishnamurthy made his **debut in 1957**.
 
• She holds the** ****title of Asthana Narthaki (‘Resident Dancer’) was bestowed upon by the Tirumala Tirupathi Devasthanam temple**.
 
• She received numerous honours for her dancing career, including** the Padma Shree (1968) **and** the Padma Bhushan (2001)**, two of the highest civilian honours given by the Indian Republic.
 
• In **1995**, she published an **autobiography 'A Passion for Dance'** with Renuka Khandekar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She studied at** Rukmini Devi Arundale's Kalakshetra, a renowned institution for the dance style**, where she acquired the fundamental techniques and worked with renowned dancers** Kanchipuram Ellapa Pillai and Thanjavur Kittappa Pillai**.
 
• Additionally,** Pankaj Charan Das and Kelucharan Mohapatra taught her Kuchipudi and Odissi**. 
 
• She received **training in vocal music from Karnataka and also learned to play the instrument vina**.
 
• In Delhi, she founded the **Yamini School of Dance in 1990**.
 
• On **March 8, 2014, on the ocassion of Women's Day**, the **Shambhavi School of Dance presented her with the "Natya Shastra" award at "Nayika-Excellence Personified."**
